content: Forex backtest realism: spread is the dominant cost on majors (varies by session, widens at rollover and news) - model it from MT5 spread column or fixed pips; intrabar OHLC cannot resolve which of SL/TP was hit first in the same bar - resolve conservatively (SL first) or use lower-timeframe/tick data for the resolution window; limit orders at SMC zone entries fill only if price trades through; weekend gaps and Monday opens must not fill at Friday closes; slippage assumptions and survivorship of curated setups silently inflate results.
